question_text: What was the peak head_count observed at DemoBooth_NVIDIA on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: The peak head_count at camera_location DemoBooth_NVIDIA on 2025-12-08 (UTC) was 86.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'})
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
RETURN max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_head_count
